$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the photography-family pack composed with a heritage portrait studio's content seed (Ashgrove Portrait Studio, Hudson NY), re-registered in the darkroom register (the portrait studio after dark) with its own pinned page skeletons — the seed's `home.layout: "specimens"` sets one full-bleed black-and-white plate over the prints, one sitting in four processes matted like museum prints — and its own appointments seed, mirrored from the seed module.
title: Ashgrove — Heritage Portrait Studio
description: A Hudson Valley portrait studio's site in the darkroom register (charcoal and silver, an old-style book serif with engraved capitals): one full-bleed black-and-white photograph of a family beside the studio's 8x10 camera — Sit for a portrait your great-grandchildren will keep — then the prints: one sitting in silver gelatin, platinum palladium, tintype and cyanotype, each matted like a museum print with its note and price on an engraved plaque, the sitting and the ask, recent sittings at one size, the studio, the archive and kind words.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module codeAppointments entry for entry (the remix-seed test pins the twin) — the composed template's Manage session calendar and booking widget open on the documentary offering: the half day books straight off the weekend calendar; full days and day-in-the-life days start with a planning call because they run past the booking domain's 240-minute slot ceiling. One provider: a one-photographer studio.

types.name: Family sitting

types.name: Portrait sitting

theme.$comment: The darkroom register's brand overlay: mode dark opens the site in its native charcoal print-room appearance (the appearance toggle still swaps to the silver-paper light reading), and the register's silver rides as the project brand so app-side surfaces (the code-gated proofing room's chrome, the booking widget) read in the same ink.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the darkroom register (the portrait studio after dark: charcoal and silver, Crimson Pro with Cinzel engraved capitals, the specimens board as matted museum prints on engraved plaques, a hairline ask), and pages carries exactly the skeletons familyLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the builder home (a full-bleed hero, the session builder, the selected-work wall, the photographer, the collections, one voice, the booking banner) — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/PhotographyFamily/familyLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
